John Lloyd Young reprises his Tony-winning role of legendary lead singer Frankie Valli, alongside Erich Bergen as the group's co-writer Bob Gaudio. The story of their trials and triumphsare accompanied by the songs that influenced a generation, including "Sherry," Big Girls Don't Cry," Walk Like a Man," and many more --classic hits that are now being embraced by a new generation of fans through the musical that's been running on Broadway for more than eight years.

programme.title: Dunkirk (2017)
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Christopher Nolan writes, directs and produces this wartime epic action thriller. Dunkirk opens as hundreds of thousands of British and Allied troops find themselves surrounded by enemy forces in the Northern French City during 1940 World War II. Trapped on the beach with the sea at their backs, they face an impossible situation as the German troops close in. The story unfolds on land, sea and air. RAF Spitfires engage the enemy in the skies above the Channel, trying to protect the defenseless men below. Meanwhile, a quickly assembled British fleet led the legendary evacuation of over 300,000 Allied military forces in what Prime Minister Winston Churchill would call a "miracle of deliverance."

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.113: The Forest Food Bandit / The Case of the Absent Giraffe
programme.desc: No one's food is safe in the forest when a mysterious thief nabs everyone's supply. // Sam and Kit are on the case when Gordy the giraffe goes missing.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.412: The Crew Builds A Houseboat / The Crew Builds A Spa
programme.desc: The pups give Omar, Juniper, Lucas, and Lily the best vacation ever by transforming their house into a floating houseboat! // Rubble & Crew want to treat Auntie Crane to a special spa day for all her hard work... until Speed Meister gets in the way!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.413: The Crew Builds A Sporting Goods Store / The Crew Plays Construction Vehicle Soccer
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew help Coach Karima and Shopkeeper Shelley team up to open Builder Cove's first ever sporting goods store. // The pups move a giant watermelon for Farmer Zoe. But when squirrels get in the way, Rubble & Crew have to play to save the day!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S6 Ep.623: Pups Rescue a Rescuer / Pups Save the Phantom of the Frog Pond
programme.desc: Mayor Goodway tries to help the PAW Patrol rescue Danny, but the pups end up having to rescue the rescuer, too! // A spooky sound forces frogs from their home. The pups must bring them home and solve the mystery of the frog pond phantom

programme.title: PAW Patrol S13 Ep.1301: Pups Solve a Snap-N-Wrap Problem / Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
programme.desc: Before Chickaletta's playdate with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap. // Mayor Humdinger loses his voice on the day of the Annual Adventure Bay Sing-Off

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.107: Barbaprank! / The Wolf of Halloween
programme.desc: It is pranks day. The Barbababies have fun finding new pranks... until Barbabright spots the track of a dinosaur. // For Halloween, the Barbababies play wolf and have fun scaring each other.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.122: Barbabright Has a Secret / Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.219: Rebels / Barbascience
programme.desc: Barbidur and Barbalala become little rebels. // But who are the Barbapapa?

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.118: Triton's Trumpet / The Curse of the Pirate Baby
programme.desc: Santiago and crew must retrieve a powerful undersea artifact after it's stolen by Enrique. // Bonnie Bones transforms into a baby and it's up to the good pirates to change her back.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.117: Santiago and Bonnie to the Rescue / The Compass Caper
programme.desc: After getting stranded at the bottom of a crevice, Bonnie and Santiago must team up to save the day. // Santiago is on a mad dash to get his compass back after it's nabbed by Bonnie Bones and Sir Butterscotch.

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S1 Ep.113: Story Time with Blue
programme.desc: We are almost ready to read but first we need to play Blue's Clues to figure out Blue's favorite story! While looking for clues, we help Shovel & Pail act out "Jack & Jill" and match the three bears with their belongings.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.209: Emily Elephant
programme.desc: There's a new pupil at the playgroup, Emily Elephant. Everybody wants to be her friend because she is very good at building blocks and can make a loud noise with her trunk.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.210: George's Friend
programme.desc: George and Rebecca Rabbit's little brother Richard each have a toy dinosaur but they are not very good at sharing their toys. Mummy Pig shows them that they can have much more fun at the playground if they play together, just like their big sisters.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.211: The Boat Pond
programme.desc: Peppa and her family and friends are playing at the pond with their toy boats. Everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit. Daddy Pig makes Rebecca a boat out of newspaper. Rebecca’s paper boat is so nice; everyone wants one.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.212: Mr Scarecrow
programme.desc: The birds keep eating the seeds from Grandpa Pig's flower garden. Peppa and George make a scarecrow, which stops the birds from eating. But Peppa is worried that the birds are hungry, so Granny Pig gives the birdies a birdfeeder with their own seeds.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.213: The Time Capsule
programme.desc: Peppa and her school friends are making a time capsule. They each put one of their favourite things inside and bury it in the school garden. The children discover that their parents made a time capsule many years ago.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.214: Recycling
programme.desc: Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig tells them that bottles go into a special green box to be recycled. Old newspapers go in a red box and tins go in a blue box. Peppa and George have fun filling the boxes.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.215: Daddy Pig's Office
programme.desc: Peppa and George are visiting Daddy Pig’s office today. Daddy Pig works with Mr Rabbit and Mrs Cat. Mr. Rabbit’s job is all about numbers, Mrs Cat‘s job is all about drawing shapes on the computer, and Daddy Pig’s job is complicated.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.216: Pirate Island
programme.desc: Grandpa and Granny Pig are taking Peppa, George and their friends to Pirate Island. Grandpa shows how to use his metal detector to find treasures and they all build a big sandcastle.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.217: Jumble Sale
programme.desc: Peppa’s playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and her friends bring in an old toy but they soon realise that favourite toys can be hard to let go of.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.218: Swimming
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. Rebecca Rabbit is there too. She and Peppa are very proud of their swimming skills. Everyone is surprised to discover that Daddy Pig is very good at swimming and diving. Very good indeed.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.219: Foggy Day
programme.desc: Mummy and Daddy Pig are taking Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it gets a bit foggy, and soon it is so foggy they can’t see. They decide to go home. But which way is home?

programme.title: DORA S3 Ep.306: Halloween’s Been Swiped / The Pumpkin Party Mystery
programme.desc: Dora and Boots find out who's been "swiping" everyone's candy and save Halloween! // Dora and Boots solve the mystery of the missing pumpkin just in time for everyone to celebrate the Pumpkin Party!

programme.title: Dora S2 Ep.210: Too Many Swipers
programme.desc: Dora and Boots help Swiper re-join with his duplicates and make it to Grandma's picnic.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S2 Ep.209: New Rules / Lemonade
programme.desc: After damaging a patch of grass, Daisy and Mr. Crocodile go overboard trying to prevent another mishap. // When Mr. Crocodile and Daisy set up a lemonade stand, Winston competes with his blueberry-ade.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.103: Boris / Born To Be Wild
programme.desc: The barbababies find a lost baby elephant and secretly look after it. How will Barbapapa and Barbamama react to Boris? // Boris the elephant misses home. The Barbapapa decide to bring him back to Africa. On the spot, they help Boris to acclimatize.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.202: Princess For A Day
programme.desc: Barbabelle proudly announces to her family that she wants to become a princess.

programme.title: Tomorrow Today: Who was the shaman of Bad Dürrenberg?

programme.desc: No other sector in Germany employs as few women as the construction industry. The few female construction workers face many challenges—including sexism. This report follows four of them.

programme.title: DW News

programme.desc: Everyone knows the Mona Lisa. But Leonardo da Vinci was much more than a painter. He designed flying machines, studied nature and anatomy, and experimented relentlessly.

programme.title: DocFilm: Last Refuge from Deportation - Church Asylum Under Scrutiny
programme.desc: For more than 40 years, German churches have been offering refugees church asylum. But this is not a legal right. And the practice is increasingly being called into question by German authorities.
